fix(core): stamp libraryInfo.version with the version being released (#1338)

Since #1141 stopped committing version bumps, packages/core/package.json on
master stayed at 2.21.4, and the build that runs before semantic-release baked
that into info.ts/info.js. Every release since 2.22.0 reports
context.library.version 2.21.4.

Add a local semantic-release prepare plugin for core that runs after
@semantic-release/npm's prepare, rebuilds with SEGMENT_LIBRARY_VERSION set to
nextRelease.version, and refuses to publish if src/info.ts or lib/*/info.js
don't carry that version. constants-generator.js reads the env var and falls
back to package.json for local builds.
